notes.title: Regarding the issue of the game not being able to start
notes.content:
If you find that the game cannot start, please disconnect from the network and try again.

Due to technical issues with the upstream manufacturer in the backend that have not been resolved, we apologize for any inconvenience caused

notes.title: The Crazy Monster Trial version has been launched!
notes.content: The Crazy Monster Trial version was successfully launched on the store page on February 6, 2024. Welcome everyone to come and try it out!
